image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a pile of baby bibs. The dominant subject is a pale pink fabric bib with a rounded shape, pink piping trim, and embroidered floral patterns (yellow flowers, green leaves). Behind it are other bibs: one white with a printed design and a clear plastic pocket containing a card, and a dark brown polka-dot bib at the bottom right. The lighting is soft and diffuse.

To verify the integrity of the piping/trim and ensure the embroidered patterns are structurally connected to the fabric without melting or bleeding artifacts.
To assess overall texture consistency, lighting realism, and detect any subtle generative noise in the fabric weave or embroidery details.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the embroidery on the pink bib. In AI images, embroidery often looks like a flat print or melts into the fabric. Verify if the threads have perceived depth and texture. Also, check the transition between the pink piping and the main fabric body for any color bleeding or structural fusion.
